shots.text: Veyra was a city of lanterns that never went dark.
Their light came from memories: the fading ones, given freely.
Beneath the city, an engine of crystal and runes turned them into light.
They called it the Reliquary.
It was built by a king who was also an engineer.
His name was Aurelian.
Then came the Long War. Twenty years of it.
To end it, he taught the engine to tear a soldier out of every mind that knew him.
The enemy broke. But the council saw what their king now held.
Afraid of him, they took the engine and named him the butcher of the war he had won.
His sentence was his own weapon: the Unwriting.
Every memory of him was torn from every mind in Veyra.
His statues fell. His name was chiseled from the stone.
Even those who loved him forgot he had ever lived.
For years, he wandered the ruins beyond the wall.
Once, he came back in secret, to see his daughter.
She looked straight at him, and saw a stranger.
That was the day his grief became hatred.
He did not come back for his throne.
He came back for the engine they had stolen.
That night, he fed it the council. Then thousands more.
Every light in Veyra went dark. They call it the Hush.
When the light returned, the king and the engine were one.
A hundred years later, he still rules. His servants live for decades more.
Those who defy him are unwritten. No one can keep a memory of them: the Forgotten.
From what is taken, his memorists shape monsters: the Hollows.
Steel passes through a Hollow like smoke.
Only a memory can wound a memory.
So the people learned to burn their own. They call it Echo.
And a few of them learned to fight back.
